# Document conversion fixtures

These fixtures are copied from the maintained document-conversion source fork
at commit `e754e1d33a1a540ebc9226e36f11d3f401852c9e`.

They are retained only for native integration tests and cover the canonical
input families supported by `Capabilities.document_conversion`.

The upstream MIT license is preserved at
`src/Capabilities/document_conversion/_vendor/UPSTREAM_LICENSE_MIT`.
